crop_image_with_bbox: crop an image to a bounding box using xywh format coordinates and return the cropped numpy array
make_bbox_square: convert a bounding box in xywh format to a square shape with optional expansion factor from center
bbox_xy_to_wh: convert bounding box coordinates from xyxy absolute format to xywh absolute format using detectron2 BoxMode
bbox_wh_to_xy: convert bounding box coordinates from xywh absolute format to xyxy absolute format using detectron2 BoxMode
compute_iou: compute the intersection over union between two bounding boxes supporting both numpy arrays and torch tensors
